messages:
maya-cs: OysterAI onboarding — need APAC egress provisioning and temporary QPS lift for Friday demo. Sales says prod tokens will be issued 5/6. Can netops help open peering/allowlist?

alex-netops: Yep. Need the customer CIDRs, desired regions (sg/tok/hk), and whether they expect source-NAT or direct peering. Also clear timeframe for auto-revoke?

maya-cs: Customer sent details — pasting below. Please treat as PII-lite.
```
Customer: OysterAI
Contact: ops@oyster.ai
CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.128/25
Regions: ap-southeast-1 (sg), ap-northeast-1 (tok)
Requested QPS (temp): 120 -> 180 for demo window (2026-05-06 08:00 - 2026-05-06 12:00 UTC)
Auto-revoke: yes, 96h preferred
```

chris-se: FYI — renewal check flagged them as 'yellow' (low usage, concerned about latency). This demo is a big opportunity. Can we prioritize edge routing to SG and enable prefix caching so latency looks good? I'll run a short enablement for their engs next week. :thumbsup:

ben-ops: I'll spin up an infra ticket and pre-authorize a temp rate bump. Opening INF-4721 now and tagging netops. Will set provisional QPS=180, auto-revoke after 96h unless CS requests extension. Need confirmation that those CIDRs are allowed by our firewall policy.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: INF-4721 — Temporary QPS lift (180) for OysterAI; assignees: alex-netops, ben-ops. ETA for peering config: 24-36h.

alex-netops: Confirmed. I will add the CIDRs to the APAC egress allowlist and create the peering request. Question: do we route via our NAT gateway or request a dedicated peering with their provider? Dedicated peering gives lower p99 but requires peering setup time.

maya-cs: Sales prefers dedicated peering if feasible — will reduce jitter for their demo. If peering blocks, NAT fallback is fine. Please set NAT as fallback in the ticket.

ben-ops: Noted. I'll include a fallback. Also will attach a short runbook for CS & SEs to validate connectivity: port checks, sample curl, and token usage.

chris-se: I'll prepare the 30-min enablement (demo: routing, token rotation, telemetry). Maya pls send a calendar invite to their team for Mon 10am PT. Also want a quick patch in Console to surface token-level latency for them — can we get a one-off dashboard link?

alex-netops: I can generate a shared dashboard link scoped to their org for the demo. Will post URL in INF-4721 when ready.

maya-cs: Great. I'll update the customer and capture feedback during the enablement. Note on renewal risk: mark the account as "engaging" after demo if metrics improve — we'll schedule a renewal touchpoint 2 weeks after demo.

ben-ops: INF-4721 updated: peering requested, NAT fallback, allowlist entries added. Auto-revoke set to 96h. Dashboard link placeholder added (will update).

alex-netops: Peering kickoff scheduled with infra-sd team — target to complete in 28h. Will post progress. :eyes:

maya-cs: Thanks team — pinging @oyster-ops to submit final confirmation and any additional CIDRs. Will follow up with invite and pre-demo checklist. :pray:

chris-se: I'll collect post-demo feedback via short CSAT + one free hour of enablement if they hit the target metrics. Capture notes in CS playbook.

maya-cs: Closing loop here — will update thread after customer confirms IPs.
